title: Hydraulic Shock Strut Gauges – Extension 1.38 Effective Length
description: For aircraft tires and hydraulic shock struts, inflates, deflates, and gauges. Screw type- locking chuck part number 9043, securely attaches to valve. Inflate through side inlet tank valve. Drain cock for bleeding pressures. Gauges area accurate to within 2%, -1%, -2% of total dial range. All gauges have ecalibration screws to permit adjustments. Extensions 331, 356 and 349 packed with 8874.
